package main

import (
	"context"
	"log"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"

	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/config"
	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/infrastructure/persistence/clickhouse"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	cfg := config.MustLoad()

	client, err := clickhouse.NewClient(ctx, cfg.ClickHouseDSN)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("failed to connect clickhouse: %v", err)
	}

	files, err := filepath.Glob("migrations/*.up.sql")
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("failed to list migrations: %v", err)
	}
	sort.Strings(files)
	if len(files) == 0 {
		log.Println("no migrations found")
		return
	}

	for _, f := range files {
		sqlBytes, err := os.ReadFile(f)
		if err != nil {
			log.Fatalf("failed to read migration %s: %v", f, err)
		}
		log.Printf("applying migration %s", f)
		if err := client.Conn().Exec(ctx, string(sqlBytes)); err != nil {
			log.Fatalf("migration %s failed: %v", f, err)
		}
	}

	log.Println("migrations applied")
}
